title: City Brew Coffee — AM Review Board
subtitle: Brainstorm City Brew summer drinks social ideas
guardrails: Use real client assets where possible. AI mockups are visual direction only. Do not invent product claims, offers, or drink names.

ideas.title: Summer Drink Field Guide
ideas.dependency: Approved drink names/taste notes/assets if product-specific.
ideas.summary: Saveable guide by flavor lane: bright + icy / creamy + sweet / coffee-forward / afternoon treat.
ideas.visual_direction: Saveable guide by flavor lane: bright + icy / creamy + sweet / coffee-forward / afternoon treat.
ideas.caption: Draft caption after drink names and approved assets are confirmed.
assets_needed: Fallback: graphic treatment using approved product categories
ideas.room_notes: Moxie: Moxie kill gate: Overall: Strong strategic set, but keep it lane-based until drink details are confirmed. 1) Summer Drink Field Guide — Keep — Best survivor because it builds order confidence, is saveable, and avoids needing exact product claims. 2) Barista Pick My Summer Drink — Revise — Good human hook, but script must stay mood/craving-led instead of pretending baristas can recommend specific unconfirmed drinks. 3) Mountain West Errand Loop — Keep — Feels most ownable for City Brew because it ties summer drinks to local routine, not generic beverage content. 4) Summer Drink Roll Call — Revise — Useful engagement mechanic, but too light alone; make it a Stories companion that feeds into the Field Guide or Barista Reel. Survivors: Summer Drink Field Guide, Mountain West Errand Loop, Barista Pick My Summer Drink, Summer Drink Roll Call as support. Riff: ## Riff production pass: O…
